ai_usage_buckets_scope_user_check.name: ai_usage_buckets_scope_user_check
ai_usage_buckets_scope_user_check.value:
(
        ("ai_usage_buckets"."scope_type" = 'user' and "ai_usage_buckets"."user_id" is not null)
        or ("ai_usage_buckets"."scope_type" = 'global' and "ai_usage_buckets"."user_id" is null)
      )

quests_archive_state_check.name: quests_archive_state_check
quests_archive_state_check.value:
(
        ("quests"."status" = 'active' and "quests"."archived_at" is null)
        or ("quests"."status" = 'archived' and "quests"."archived_at" is not null)
      )
